I want to be very precise here because everyone online is being sloppy: Station 7-Fornax DOES have outbound comms. It has two functioning relay nodes. What it lacks is a connection to the Galactic Oversight Grid, which is different. Outbound comms exist. Grid-audited comms do not. These are not the same thing and the distinction matters enormously for what we can actually infer about Secretary Morel's intentions.
